scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Cultural Organizations With National Presence
other_conditions: The organization must have a properly constituted managing or governing body with powers, duties and responsibilities defined in a written constitution.
The organization must be registered in India and have an all‑India character with national (and optionally international) operational presence.
The organization’s activities must be primarily or significantly cultural.
The organization must be capable of conducting at least 20 cultural events/programmes in a year.
The organization must have adequate working strength of artistes, staff and volunteers.
The organization must have spent ₹1 crore or more on cultural activities in three of the last five years.
The organization must organize at least two activities in schools and provide a certificate from the school principal for the release of the second installment.
Applications pending previous grant/utilization certificate will not be considered.
The organization must not invite foreign delegations without permission from the Ministry of External Affairs.
The organization must not engage in canvassing for the scheme, which is a disqualification.
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹2 crore (₹5 crore in exceptional cases), covering up to 67% of the approved project cost, with the remaining 33% to be borne by the organization as a matching share.
documents_required: Two copies of the complete application form, signed by the authorized signatory and stamped with the organization’s seal
Index of documents attached to the application
Certificate from the principal of a school confirming the organization has conducted at least two activities in schools
Recommendation/endorsement from the Cultural Department/Wing of the concerned Central/State/UT Administration or a Zonal Cultural Center or National Academy
Utilisation Certificate in GFR‑19(e) format, audited statement of accounts, and Chartered Accountant certification
